name: Open WebUI Computer (Rootless AI Agent)
install_cmd: ACCOUNT_HOME=$(getent passwd "$(id -u)" 2>/dev/null | awk -F: 'NR==1{print $6}'); [ -d "$ACCOUNT_HOME" ] || ACCOUNT_HOME=/home/$(id -un); PY=''; for CANDIDATE in "${PYTHON_BIN:-}" python3.14 python3.13 python3.12 python3.11 python3.10 "$ACCOUNT_HOME"/virtualenv/*/*/bin/python* "$ACCOUNT_HOME"/.pyenv/versions/*/bin/python* "$ACCOUNT_HOME"/.local/share/uv/python/*/bin/python* /opt/alt/python314/bin/python3.14 /opt/alt/python313/bin/python3.13 /opt/alt/python312/bin/python3.12 /opt/alt/python311/bin/python3.11 /opt/alt/python310/bin/python3.10 python3; do [ -n "$CANDIDATE" ] || continue; if [[ "$CANDIDATE" != */* ]]; then CANDIDATE=$(command -v "$CANDIDATE" 2>/dev/null || true); fi; [ -x "$CANDIDATE" ] || continue; if "$CANDIDATE" -c 'import sys; raise SystemExit(0 if sys.version_info >= (3,10) else 1)' >/dev/null 2>&1; then PY=$CANDIDATE; break; fi; done; [ -n "$PY" ] || { echo 'ERROR: Python 3.10+ was not found. Set PYTHON_BIN to the absolute Python path in project environment variables.' >&2; exit 1; }; echo "Using Python: $PY ($($PY --version 2>&1))"; if ! "$PY" -m pip --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then "$PY" -m ensurepip --user || { echo 'ERROR: pip is unavailable for the selected Python.' >&2; exit 1; }; fi; mkdir -p storage data; if [ ! -x storage/venv/bin/python ] || ! storage/venv/bin/python -c 'import sys; raise SystemExit(0 if sys.version_info >= (3,10) else 1)' >/dev/null 2>&1; then rm -rf storage/venv storage/virtualenv-bootstrap; "$PY" -m venv storage/venv 2>/dev/null || { "$PY" -m pip install --target storage/virtualenv-bootstrap --upgrade virtualenv && PYTHONPATH=storage/virtualenv-bootstrap "$PY" -m virtualenv storage/venv; }; fi; storage/venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip wheel; storage/venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade cptr; echo 'Open WebUI Computer installed without sudo, apt, or Docker.'
start_cmd: mkdir -p data; export CPTR_DATA_DIR="$PWD/data"; exec storage/venv/bin/cptr run --host 0.0.0.0 --port "${PORT:-8000}" --headless
